summary: Rogue River NF lookout site: a 10x10 L-5 cab built in 1936 was removed or destroyed in 1968; a marker and rectangular foundation remain on the summit.

facts.status_note: Cab removed or destroyed in 1968; Oregon Hikers reports a rectangular foundation and a marker remain
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service (Rogue River National Forest)

access.note: Oregon Hikers describes a trail up to the summit marker; the sources mention no closure or permit

visit.trail_note: No tower stands; the Stein Butte Trail leads to the summit

events.note: Panorama photographs taken, per the Oregon Lookouts history
10x10 L-5 cab; the register places it on a minor point about a mile west-northwest of the summit
Ten dollars spent on water development, per the Oregon Lookouts history
Register says removed; firelookout.com and Oregon Lookouts say destroyed

evidence.supports: L-5 cab built 1936 on a minor point one mile west-northwest of the summit; removed 1968
evidence.quote: Built in 1936 atop a minor point one mile west northwest of the summit, this L-5 cab was removed in 1968.

evidence.supports: site lies in the Rogue River National Forest
site lies in Jackson County, Oregon

evidence.quote: May 2, 1934: Panorama photos taken by James Rittenhouse.

evidence.supports: ten dollars spent on water development in 1937
evidence.quote: 1937: The sum of ten dollars expended on water development.

evidence.supports: large marker on the summit marks the cabin's life, 1936-1968
evidence.quote: A large "tombstone" proclaims the life of the L-5 lookout cabin (1936-1968) on the summit of Stein Butte

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says the cab was removed in 1968; firelookout.com and Oregon Lookouts say it was destroyed. All three agree on the year.
The register puts the cab on a minor point about a mile west-northwest of the summit; Oregon Hikers puts the marker and rectangular foundation on the summit. The story reports both.

sources.title: Stein Butte Lookout Site, Former Fire Lookout Sites register

notes_for_editor: No staffing or notable fire found in the four pages, so the story leaves both out. The Oregon Lookouts history lists only construction, a 1937 water entry and the 1968 loss. A Forest Service trail page for Stein Butte appeared in search results but was not read; the public-access level rests on Oregon Hikers alone. The sources disagree on where the cab stood (minor point versus summit marker), and the story says so. A search summary claimed CCC construction, but none of the cited pages say that, so it is left out.
